'''Souske''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Fate of the Jedi" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> who served as the security chief aboard the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|''Oppressor'']], the personal warship of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A fair-skinned Human with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] cut in a [[double stripe]] pattern, Souske wore black [[Imperial soldier]] armor with red markings, like many other members of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]], and carried a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] in battle.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Angral [[Battle of the Oppressor|attacked]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the homeworld of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], in order to use the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] against the world. However, a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] and the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] infiltrated the ''Oppressor'' while the Desolator was charging, and Souske was [[Death/Legends|killed]] while trying to stop the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from reaching the bridge.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
Souske first appeared in the Jedi Knight mission "Fate of the Jedi" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], where they are an elite NPC aboard the ''Oppressor'' that must be fought in order to reach Darth Angral.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi" />
